description: This Java class implements a command strategy for fetching a datatable entry by application table ID and datatable ID within the Apache Fineract batch processing framework. It interacts with the DatatablesApiResource to retrieve data based on URL parsing and query parameters, and handles the response and potential errors.

classes.name: GetDatatableEntryByAppTableIdAndDataTableIdCommandStrategy
classes.description: Implements command execution to retrieve datatable entries based on appTableId and dataTableId, utilizing the DatatablesApiResource and handling URL parsing and query parameters.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command to fetch datatable entries using parameters from the BatchRequest, constructs the response, and manages URL parsing and query parameters.
